name: License Text Generator
description: Generate the full text of MIT, Apache 2.0 or GPL-3.0 licenses with your name and year filled in — ready to save as LICENSE.
body:
License text

Choose a license and generate its full text.
howto: Choose a license — MIT, Apache 2.0 or GPL-3.0.
Enter the copyright holder name and the year.
Review the full legal text with your details inserted.
Download it as a LICENSE file and place it in your repo root.
features: Complete text of MIT, Apache 2.0 and GPL-3.0
Copyright holder and year filled in automatically
Copy or download as a LICENSE file
Handy per-license summary of what it allows

faq.a: MIT is permissive and popular for most projects. Apache 2.0 adds explicit patent protection. GPL-3.0 is a copyleft license that requires derivative works to stay open. Pick based on your goals.
No. The text is the official license boilerplate, but if you are unsure, consult a lawyer — especially for company or commercial projects.

faq.q: Where should the license file go?
faq.a: In the project root, named LICENSE or LICENSE.md. Most platforms and package managers read it automatically from there.
No. The text is generated locally in your browser.
